summary.en: Russia is intensifying air and missile strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure, targeting power facilities, the Northern Bridge, and emergency crews, while Ukrainian forces are hitting Russian missile launchers, air-defence systems in Bryansk Oblast and the Saratov oil refinery. Iran has delivered a secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pursues a gas pipeline deal, and Azerbaijan and Ukraine have signed new energy-defence and trade agreements, with Zelensky urging Latin America to help rebuild Ukraine's power grid. Europe will join US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi, and space is becoming a critical domain in the war. 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Russland intensiverer luft‑ og missilangrep mot ukrainsk infrastruktur, og rammer kraftverk, den nordlige broen og redningsmannskaper, mens ukrainske styrker treffer russiske missilutskytere og luftvernsystemer i Bryansk-oblast samt Saratov-oljeraffineriet. Iran har levert en hemmelig Khamenei-melding til Putin mens Moskva forfølger en gassrørledningsavtale, og Aserbajdsjan og Ukraina har signert nye energi-forsvars‑ og handelsavtaler, med Zelensky som oppfordrer Latin-Amerika til å hjelpe med å gjenoppbygge Ukrainas strømnett. Europa vil delta i US-medierte forhandlinger i Abu Dhabi, og rommet blir en kritisk arena i krigen. 75 767 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)
background.extract: On 24 February 2022, Russia invaded Ukraine, starting the largest and deadliest war in Europe since World War II, in a major escalation of the existing war between the two countries that began when Russia attacked Ukraine in 2014. The fighting has caused hundreds of thousands of military casualties and tens of thousands of Ukrainian civilian casualties. Russian troops occupy roughly 20% of Ukraine. From a population of 41 million, about 8 million Ukrainians have been internally displaced and 6–7 million have fled the country, creating Europe's largest refugee crisis since World War II.
background.extractNb: Russlands invasjon av Ukraina 2022 begynte tidlig om morgenen 24. februar, da russiske styrker gjennomførte et stort angrep på Ukraina. Dette var en kraftig opptrapping av krigen i Ukraina, som har pågått siden 2014 og blant annet omfattet okkupasjon av Krym. Invasjonen har ført til titusenvis av døde på hver side, og ledet til Europas største flyktningkrise siden andre verdenskrig. Om lag 8 millioner ukrainere var internflyktninger i juni 2022, og over 8 millioner hadde flyktet fra landet i mai 2023.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️Ukrainian forces reportedly strike Russia's second-largest oil refinery in overnight drone attack.

The attack caused large explosions at the Kirishi Petroleum Organic Synthesis plant, also known as the Kinef plant, around 800 kilometers (roughly 500 miles) north of Ukraine.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️Ukraine will likely 'end up with a little bit different shape' after war, Trump tells 60 Minutes.

"​​There's a very important meeting taking place," Trump said. "I believe that that war is going to end and it's going to end soon. And the only reason it's going to end is because of me."

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️Power to Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant cut, restored, IAEA says.

The plant lost connection to its sole 330-kilovolt external power line, forcing it to rely on emergency diesel generators for cooling and safety functions, the IAEA announced around noon local time.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️'Accomplices in Russian war crimes' — Kyiv calls for boycott, defunding of world hockey org after Russia allowed in championship. 

"Bureaucrats who make decisions about the return of Russians to international competitions are staining themselves with blood," Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️Ukrainian drones hit key bridge, power stations in Russia's Rostov Oblast, governor says. 

Drone debris reportedly damaged the bridge over the Mius River, located on the R-280 highway — a strategic road that links Rostov Oblast with several Russian-occupied regions in Ukraine, including Crimea.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️Zelensky tasks PM with creating free transportation program in Kyiv as Russia's bridge attacks hinder travel. 

According to the president's advisor, Dmytro Lytvyn, the plan's details could be presented as soon as tomorrow.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
South African tech entrepreneur and filmmaker Ronnie Apteker has spent 19 years living in Ukraine and documenting its people, culture, and evolving identity. 

Through his documentary series “Kyiv of Mine,” he wants to show a country that exists far beyond the headlines of Russia’s war.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️ 3 people, including child, die in Kyiv Oblast from improperly running generator as Russia slams power grids across Ukraine.

The State Emergency Service said the victims died of carbon monoxide poisoning because they ran the generator in the basement instead of outside, at a safe distance.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️Europe to participate in Abu Dhabi peace talks, French foreign minister says.

“The Europeans will be well represented, and France will be in Abu Dhabi to take part in these discussions,” French Foreign Minister said.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️ Russia to replace Norway in ice hockey championship as more countries vow to boycott games.

In the new layout of the 2027 World Junior Hockey Championship, which is due to take place in Canada from Dec. 26, 2026, to Jan. 5, 2027, Russia will place tenth.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️ Moscow police detain over 200 people, reportedly forcing some to sign military contracts.

Detainees told the Russian Telegram channel “Ostorozhno, Novosti” that those over the age of 18 were “persistently” urged to sign a contract with Russia’s Defense Ministry.
